newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BONDS, SWAPS, DEPOS STABLE IN LATE DEALS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BONDS, SWAPS, DEPOS STABLE IN LATE DEALS.

text.p: All markets were quiet late on Thursday, in view of Greek Orthodox Easter holidays and trading was very thin, dealers said.
Markets will be closed on Friday, Monday and next Thursday.
"The market is stagnant. Most players have probably gone for the holidays," the dealer added.
The ecu/drachma rate slipped to 309.11-21, a state bank forex dealer said.
"There were some sales of ecus for drachmas on Thursday, mainly by domestic investors," the dealer added.
The mark was quoted at 158.75/85 from Thursday's 158.770 fix, the dollar at 272.99/09 drachmas from 272.900 and the ecu at 309.16/26 from 309.180 drachmas.
